item.title: Historic Tucson tower gets a $50M affordable housing makeover
item.description: Tucson House in Arizona is undergoing a major renovation to provide affordable housing for older adults. The project is expected to create 358 modern apartments by summer 2028, improving accessibility for residents aged 55 and older. Twenty-five households have already moved into the newly renovated 15th-floor apartments within ten months of commencing work. Future updates will include shared amenities such as lounges, fitness rooms, and landscaped courtyards. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: A tiny patch could help rescuers perform CPR better; student invention wins $10,000
item.description: Four University of Washington students have developed CPRight, a wallet-sized patch that uses LED lights to guide rescuers during CPR. The device provides real-time feedback on chest compression depth and rate without requiring additional equipment. The invention won the $10,000 undergraduate first prize at the 2026 Collegiate Inventors Competition, which also recognised innovations in cancer treatment, rehabilitation and neurological monitoring. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: El papa León XIV recibe el alta médica y regresa al Vaticano tras su operación de pulmón
item.description: Cuatro días después de someterse a una cirugía para la extirpación de un tumor cancerígeno en el pulmón derecho, el papa León XIV ha recibido el alta médica y dejó este sábado el hospital Gemelli de Roma. Su reaparición pública será este domingo, cuando impartirá el tradicional ángelus frente a la Plaza de San Pedro. Si bien restan conocerse los resultados de los análisis del nódulo extraído, la buena evolución alimenta las expectativas de una recuperación con miras a su esperada gira por América Latina. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: Doctors say pontiff is ‘fit for discharge’ after operation to remove cancerous tumour from his lung Pope Leo lung cancer surgery: what kind of operation did he have and what happens next? item.title: Vatican says Pope Leo to be released from the hospital on October 17, four days after lung cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo is expected to leave hospital on Saturday afternoon following surgery for lung cancer, the Vatican said, after blood tests and ‌chest imaging found him fit to return home four days after his operation. The 71-year-old pontiff, who has not been seen in public since a procedure on Tuesday to remove the lower lobe of his right lung, will also hold his first public engagement since surgery on Sunday. item.title: Uganda launches Ebola vaccine trial
item.description: The town of Masaka in southern Uganda is currently conducting a Phase 1 trial of a vaccine candidate against the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus, which is circulating in the region. There is currently no approved treatment or vaccine for this strain. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
